<item><title>Oportun: Senior Director of Product Management (R14361)</title><region>Anywhere in the World</region><country></country><state></state><category>Product</category><type>Full-Time</type><skills></skills><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 06:03:19 +0000</pubDate><link>https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-director-of-product-management-r14361</link><guid>https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-director-of-product-management-r14361</guid><description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote  - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span>The Opportunity</span></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead strategy, growth, and execution across key digital products and member experiences. You’ll help shape how Oportun serves members throughout their financial journey while building products that create meaningful customer value and support sustainable business growth.</span></p>
<p><span>This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set product direction, develop roadmaps, lead discovery, guide cross-functional execution, and coach product managers while staying close to customers, data, and product performance. Success requires strong strategic judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term vision and detailed execution.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span>What You'll Do</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll define product vision, strategy, and priorities that connect member needs with Oportun’s business objectives.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll own and evolve a portfolio of digital products and experiences, balancing growth, engagement, retention, customer value, and business performance.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll build outcome-focused roadmaps and make clear investment decisions across existing products, new capabilities, and emerging opportunities.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll develop a deep understanding of member behavior, friction points, and unmet needs through research, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort performance, and experimentation.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll lead product initiatives from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll establish clear hypotheses, success measures, and performance metrics and use results to guide future product decisions.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to resolve trade-offs and deliver strong member experiences.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll balance customer experience, growth, product economics, risk, regulatory requirements, and operational complexity when making product decisions.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll coach and develop product managers, set clear expectations, and strengthen product judgment, ownership, and accountability across the team.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll communicate product strategy, priorities, performance, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll bring ideas for how we can improve our products, processes, and ways of working, proactively, not just when asked.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and team productivity.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster</strong></span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span>Who You Are</span></strong></p>
<p><span><strong>The right fit looks like this</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’re a strategic and hands-on product leader who combines strong customer judgment with data, business acumen, and disciplined execution. You know how to build products that customers value while making thoughtful trade-offs across growth, economics, risk, and operational complexity.</span></li>
<li><span>You’re comfortable leading through ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and creating clarity across teams. You communicate directly, build strong partnerships, and stay close enough to the work to understand what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.</span></li>
<li><span>You’re also a strong people leader. You know how to coach product managers, raise the quality of product thinking, and create accountability for measurable outcomes.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.</strong></span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>What You Bring</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Skills &amp; experience</strong></span></p>
<p><span><strong>Required</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>8+ years of product management experience, with increasing responsibility for product strategy, roadmap ownership, and measurable customer and business outcomes.</span></li>
<li><span>Significant experience building and growing consumer digital products.</span></li>
<li><span>Proven experience owning engagement, retention, growth, monetization, or other meaningful product-performance outcomes.</span></li>
<li><span>3+ years of experience directly managing and developing product managers.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong track record leading cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience setting product strategy and translating it into focused, executable roadmaps.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong product judgment and a high standard for simple, intuitive, and customer-centered experiences.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong analytical skills, including experience with funnel analysis, cohort performance, product economics, experimentation, and performance measurement.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience evolving established products while balancing current customer needs with new strategic priorities.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and trade-offs.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments with competing priorities and significant ambiguity.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Experience in fintech, financial services, lending, banking, payments, savings, budgeting, investing, or financial wellness.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience building consumer mobile products or other high-engagement digital experiences.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with subscription, recurring-use, or habit-forming consumer products.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience serving customers managing complex or variable financial needs.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience working in a regulated environment and incorporating Risk, Legal, and Compliance requirements into product experiences.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience leading products through periods of growth, transformation, or significant strategic change.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience using AI tools to improve product research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, or team productivity.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Our AI Mindset</span></h2>
<h3><span>We build with AI. We lead with judgment.</span></h3>
<p><span>AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.</span></p>
<p><span>We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be <span><strong>open to experimenting</strong></span>, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when <span><strong>human judgment and AI capability work together.</strong></span></span></p>
<h2><span>Why Oportun</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>What's in it for you&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.</span></p>
<p><span>Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:</span></p>
<p><span><strong>US Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision Insurance</span></li>
<li><span>401(k) including company match</span></li>
<li><span>Flexible PTO and Parental Leave</span></li>
<li><span>Company-paid Life &amp; Disability Insurance</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit&nbsp;<span><strong>oportun.com/careers</strong></span></span></p>
<p><span>The US salary range for this full-time position is $ 174,900 - $ 279,800</span></p>
<p><span>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.</span></p>
<p><span>Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.</span></p>

<p><em><span>We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).</span></em></p></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Seattle, WA - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>About Gusto</strong></p>
<p>At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.</p>
<p>All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/total-rewards"> Total Rewards philosophy</a>.</p>
<p>AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.</p></div><h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2>
<p>We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on the financial backbone of Gusto's money movement — the ledger, reconciliation, and reporting systems that account for every dollar, and the payment profile that determines how employers fund payroll and how employees and contractors get paid. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by driving large technical architectural decisions (focusing on scale and modularity), understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!</p>
<h2><strong>About the Team:</strong></h2>
<p>Financial Data &amp; Payment Profile (FDPP) sits inside Gusto's Payments organization, which moves money safely between partners, employers, employees, government authorities, and Gusto. FDPP owns the two things that every one of those movements depends on.</p>
<p>Financial Data is the system of record for the money itself: the ledger and subledger behind every payment, the reconciliation that proves our books agree with our banks and partners, the investigation of the variances that surface when they do not, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, and Compliance depend on. When Gusto needs to answer where a dollar is — and prove it — the answer comes from systems this team builds.</p>
<p>Payment Profile is what makes a payment possible in the first place: the payment methods available to a customer, the bank accounts and connections behind them, the verification that makes those accounts trustworthy, and the profile state that decides whether a payment can happen at all. Hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on this being right the first time — and on it recovering gracefully when a bank account, a connection, or a preference changes.</p>
<h2><strong>Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Design, build, and test the financial data systems that record every dollar Gusto moves — the ledger and subledger that serve as the system of record, the transaction models underneath them, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, Compliance, and our partners rely on to close the books</li>
<li>Build reconciliation at Gusto's scale: prove that our internal records agree with bank, processor, and partner statements, and make the breaks that fall out of that comparison traceable rather than mysterious</li>
<li>Lead variance investigation end-to-end — the tooling, instrumentation, and runbooks that turn "the numbers don't tie" into a specific root cause, and then into a fix that eliminates the whole class of break</li>
<li>Own the payment profile: how employers are set up to fund payroll and how employees and contractors are set up to be paid — the payment methods available and the rules that govern which apply to whom, the bank accounts and connections behind them, and the verification state that determines whether money can move at all</li>
<li>Make setup and verification something a small business can finish on its own — instant bank verification, graceful handling of broken or revoked connections, and a clear path back to a payable state when something changes</li>
<li>Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world</li>
<li>Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Accounting, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams</li>
<li>Mentor and grow fellow engineers working to create holistic and scalable solutions</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Here’s what we're looking for:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience and the enthusiasm for a collaborative, test-driven environment</li>
<li>Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software as well as designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages</li>
<li>Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code that is maintainable, structured, and well-documented</li>
<li>An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems</li>
<li>Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs</li>
<li>Experience in one or more of these domains is strongly preferred: ledger or subledger design, financial reconciliation, accounting systems, or payments infrastructure</li>
<li>Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts — journal entries, chart of accounts, debits and credits, and tying a subledger out to the general ledger — and the ability to work with accountants and controllers in their own vocabulary</li>
<li>Experience building systems where correctness, auditability, and immutability matter more than raw throughput, and where a silent data error is worse than an outage</li>
<li>Bonus: Experience with bank account verification, payment rails (ACH, wire, RTP), or third-party banking data and verification providers</li>
<li>Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1">Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $183,000-$200,000 /yr in Denver &amp; most remote locations, and $222,000-$245,000 /yr for San Francisco, Seattle &amp; New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr>
<p>At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.</p>
<hr>
<p>Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.</p>
<p>Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.&nbsp;</p>
<p>When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.</p>
<p><strong>Reliable, consistent presence: </strong>We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.</p>
<hr>
<p><span>Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdEfl7Bp-Twz7LLlhGlha46CrxZ9Kacgakmarf3K2TbnaEgKQ/viewform">this form</a> and a member of our team will get in touch with you.</span></p>
<p>Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our <a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/fraudulent-activity-disclaimer">Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer</a>.</p>
<p>Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to&nbsp;<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/applicant-privacy-notice">Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-software-engineer-financial-data-payments">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-software-engineer-financial-data-payments</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title: Head of Channel Sales &amp; Alliances</strong></span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location: United States, Remote</strong></span></p>
<p><span><em>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</em></span></p>
<p><span><strong>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.</span></p>
<p><span>We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.</span></p>
<p><span>Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong><strong><br></strong>Own the partner channel that sources a meaningful share of Salesloft’s new closed-won revenue.</span></p>
<p><span>As our Head of Channel Sales &amp; Alliances, you'll build and run a quota-carrying Channel Sales &amp; Alliances organization focused on four motions: private equity partnerships, cloud marketplace and strategic platform alliances, ISV and MCP partnerships, and VAR, BPO, and services partnerships. The primary measure is closed-won revenue sourced through partners, supported by partner-influenced revenue and the retention and expansion of partner-sourced customers. Relationships, programs, and pipelines are critical in producing signed deals. You will be the executive face of Salesloft to our most strategic partners and the owner of the plan, the team, and the results.</span></p>
<p><span>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>Private Equity Partnerships</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Build relationships with private equity firms and their operating partners to position Salesloft as the revenue platform for their portfolio companies.</span></li>
<li><span>Structure portfolio-wide agreements and programs that turn a firm-level relationship into sourced, closed-won deals across multiple portfolio companies.</span></li>
<li><span>Work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to run portfolio-specific plays, from the initial introduction through close.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>Cloud Marketplace and Strategic Platform Alliances</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Own Salesloft's go-to-market with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including marketplace listings, private offers, and co-sell programs that let customers buy against their existing cloud commitments.</span></li>
<li><span>Build strategic alliances with the CRM and productivity platforms our customers run on, such as Salesforce, Microsoft, and HubSpot, including their app and agent marketplaces.</span></li>
<li><span>Turn platform relationships into sourced and co-sold pipeline by aligning with these partners' field sellers, not only their partner teams.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>ISV and MCP Partnerships</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Identify, recruit, and sign independent software vendors and AI platforms that integrate with, embed, or distribute Salesloft, including through MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations and agent ecosystems.</span></li>
<li><span>Define co-sell and co-marketing motions with ISV partners so that integrations produce sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue, not only technical listings.</span></li>
<li><span>Work with Product and Engineering to shape the partner integration roadmap and make sure partners can build, launch, and sell with confidence.</span></li>
<li><span>Design partner economics for AI and agent partners, including revenue share on usage- and consumption-based pricing alongside seat-based models.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>VAR, BPO, and Services Partnerships</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Recruit and onboard value-added resellers and business process outsourcing providers that resell, bundle, or deliver Salesloft as part of their sales services.</span></li>
<li><span>Recruit systems integrators and RevOps consultancies that influence enterprise buying decisions and deliver implementations, and build a services partner motion that speeds time to value and improves retention.</span></li>
<li><span>Negotiate reseller and partner agreements, pricing, margin structures, and business terms that support profitable, repeatable revenue.</span></li>
<li><span>Equip partner sellers with value-selling playbooks, competitive positioning, and qualification criteria so deals are sourced and closed consistently.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span><strong>Move as One:</strong> You’ll partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps on joint plays and partner attribution, and share credit for partner-sourced wins.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>Evidence over Ego:</strong> You’ll plan, forecast, and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue using real signals, and say so when the data changes your mind.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>Lead from the Front:</strong> You’ll be the executive face of Salesloft to strategic partners and set the quotas, coverage models, and standards your team is held to.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>Make Your Mark:</strong> You’ll shape how Salesloft shows up in private equity, cloud marketplaces, ISV and MCP ecosystems, and services channels, not just run the playbook.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR</strong><strong><br></strong>You’re a senior partner and alliances leader who has sourced and closed partner-driven revenue in B2B SaaS and led teams to quota. You build the relationships and programs that turn into signed deals, and you are credible with C-level partners and technical teams alike. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>YOU’LL BRING</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>12+ years of experience in partner sales, channel sales, alliances, or business development in B2B SaaS, with senior leadership experience managing teams</span></li>
<li><span>A track record of sourcing and closing partner-driven revenue and meeting or exceeding quota, with results you can describe in terms of closed-won revenue</span></li>
<li><span>Experience building or working with private equity relationships, ISV or technology integration partnerships, cloud marketplace and co-sell programs with AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud, or VAR, BPO, and services channel programs. Experience in more than one of these is strongly preferred</span></li>
<li><span>Experience building a partner program from the ground up, or rebuilding one after a merger or acquisition</span></li>
<li><span>An established network of private equity operating partners and portfolio company leaders</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with AI, API, and MCP-based integration ecosystems, and the ability to talk credibly with technical partners about how Salesloft fits</span></li>
<li><span>Proven ability to negotiate complex partner, reseller, and revenue-sharing agreements</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to coach and lead a team, including setting quotas and holding people accountable to them</span></li>
<li><span>Strong sales acumen and fluency with CRM and partner tools such as Salesforce, partner relationship management platforms, and account-mapping tools, including building partner attribution models. SaaS experience is required</span></li>
<li><span>Executive presence, including comfort presenting at conferences, events, and webinars and influencing C-suite stakeholders</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>THE TEAM</strong><strong><br></strong>You’ll lead the Channel Sales &amp; Alliances team of partner sales and alliance professionals and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps. It’s a place to grow as the executive owner of a channel plan, a team, and the results.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></span></p>

<p><strong>Job Title: Senior Commercial Account Manager</strong></p>
<p><strong>Location: United States, Remote</strong></p>
<p>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</p>
<p><strong>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</strong></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Senior Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Full-Cycle Account Ownership:</strong> Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.</li>
<li><strong>Driving Net-New Revenue:</strong> Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.</li>
<li><strong>Account Planning:</strong> Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.</li>
<li><strong>Proactive Retention Management:</strong> Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.</li>
<li><strong>Executive Relationship Building:</strong> Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.</li>
<li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Pipeline Accuracy:</strong> Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.</li>
<li><strong>Market &amp; Competitive Intelligence:</strong> Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Segmented Renewal Strategy:</strong> Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.</li>
</ul>
<p>In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Senior Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.</p>
<p>Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.</p>
<p>If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>Our Salesloft Senior Commercial Sales team is comprised of motivated sales professionals with a strong desire to win.</p>
<p>Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.</p>
<p>The Senior Commercial Account Management team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The AMs on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4+ years of proven relationship building and closing experience in a sales environment.</li>
<li>Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships</li>
<li>Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the SMB segment</li>
<li>Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers</li>
<li>Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.</li>
<li>Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'</li>
<li>Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning sceptics into ecstatic new customers</li>
<li>High level of empathy - it's important for our AM's to be a good person to peers and prospects.</li>
<li>Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.</li>
<li>Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.</li>
<li>Proven ability to make strong connections and overcome rejection to achieve results.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to conduct compelling on-site and virtual presentations to C-Level executives.</li>
</ul>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span>The Opportunity</span></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for a Manager, Marketing Data and Technology to own the reliability of the data and technical processes that support Oportun’s marketing ecosystem. You’ll ensure marketing data is accurate, complete, consistent, and available across platforms and internal systems to support campaign execution, measurement, attribution, and growth.</span></p>
<p><span>This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You’ll serve as the primary owner for assigned MarTech systems, integrations, and tracking processes, working independently to identify issues, recommend solutions, and drive improvements through implementation. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Analytics, Product, Engineering, and external vendors to keep systems reliable and data flowing correctly.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span>What You'll Do</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll own marketing data quality across assigned platforms and internal databases, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely delivery.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll build and maintain validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting processes to identify missing records, discrepancies, and failed data flows.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll investigate root causes of data and integration issues and drive solutions through implementation and ongoing monitoring.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll manage website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics, tag management configurations, pixels, and event implementations.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and data integrations between marketing vendors and internal systems.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll use Python or SQL to query, validate, transform, and reconcile data and automate recurring operational tasks.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll manage and troubleshoot assigned MarTech tools and configurations to support reliable data collection, audience activation, and reporting.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll establish and maintain consistent UTM parameters, campaign naming conventions, and tracking standards to improve attribution and measurement.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll identify data gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities to improve tracking, integrations, automation, and operational efficiency.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll document data flows, tracking definitions, configurations, validation procedures, and troubleshooting processes to support team continuity and reliable operations.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll coordinate with cross-functional partners and vendors on requirements, testing, releases, issue resolution, priorities, and risks.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster</strong></span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Who You Are</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>The right fit looks like this</strong></span></p>
<p><span>You’re a hands-on technical marketer who enjoys solving data and systems problems and taking ownership from issue identification through resolution. You’re comfortable working independently, but you also know when to bring in the right partners.</span></p>
<p><span>You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and process-minded. You care about data quality, clear documentation, and reliable systems, and you consistently look for ways to make technical workflows more scalable and efficient.</span></p>
<h2><span>What You Bring</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Skills &amp; experience</strong></span></p>
<p><span><strong>Required</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>5+ years of relevant experience in marketing technology, marketing data operations, data engineering, marketing analytics, or a similar technical role.</span></li>
<li><span>Proficiency in Python or SQL, with the ability to independently write, troubleshoot, and maintain code for data validation, transformation, or automation.</span></li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience managing website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics and a tag management platform such as Google Tag Manager or Tealium.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience configuring, testing, and troubleshooting REST APIs, webhooks, and data integrations.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience reconciling data across systems, implementing quality checks, and resolving underlying data issues.</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated ability to serve as the primary owner of assigned systems and processes in a small team environment.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on implementation.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and project management skills.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to work autonomously across teams, vendors, and time zones while managing competing priorities.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Experience establishing or maintaining website and digital tagging frameworks and marketing attribution data.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with Databricks, customer data platforms, Amplitude, Iterable, or similar marketing and analytics tools.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with scripting, workflow automation, scheduled data jobs, or monitoring tools.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience in financial services or another environment involving sensitive customer data.</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with data privacy, access controls, and governance requirements.</span></li>
<li><span>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, or automation.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Our AI Mindset</span></h2>
<h3><span>We build with AI. We lead with judgment.</span></h3>
<p><span><strong>AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.</strong></span></p>
<p><span>We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be <span><strong>open to experimenting</strong></span>, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when <span><strong>human judgment and AI capability work together.</strong></span></span></p>
<h2><span>Why Oportun</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>What's in it for you&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.</span></p>

<p><span>Medical Insurance&nbsp;</span><br><span>Savings Fund</span><br><span>Life Insurance</span><br><span>Internet and Electricity Allowance</span><br><span>Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave</span></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> European Union - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3><strong>About the Role:</strong></h3>
<p>You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.</p>
<p>AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.</p>
<h3><strong>Your Impact:<br></strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec</li>
<li>Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19,&nbsp;Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.</li>
<li>Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt</li>
<li>Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents</li>
<li>Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line</li>
<li>Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time</li>
<li>Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Your Qualifications:<br></strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19</li>
<li>A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket</li>
<li>Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role</li>
<li>Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already</li>
<li>Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad</li>
<li>Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Our Stack:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL</li>
<li>TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart</li>
<li>PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ</li>
<li>Unit/integration testing, Java web stack</li>
<li>AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Interested in joining Wrike when the right opportunity opens up? Apply to our Senior Builder today. We’ll reach out as soon as a suitable role becomes available, or simply to arrange a Meet &amp; Greet call.</strong></p>
<p>Your recruitment buddy will be <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/aleksandar-chernev-479785214/">Alexander Chernev</a>, Senior Recruiter.<br><br></p>
<p><span>#LI-AC1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Who Is Wrike and Our Culture</strong></h3>
<div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div><strong>Hybrid work mode</strong></div>
<div><br>
<div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3>About the Role</h3>
<p>Are you ready to become a Wriker? Wrike is looking for a US remote <strong>Senior Director, Growth &amp; Demand Marketing</strong> to lead our global demand generation engine, scale high-impact ABM programs, and drive enterprise pipeline growth.</p>
<p>You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. In this strategic leadership role, you will oversee integrated campaigns, field marketing, ABM and events. You will act as the principal architect of our buyer journey-driven marketing strategies, designing and executing integrated campaigns that position Wrike as the essential collaborative work management (CWM) system of record. Partnering closely with Sales VPs, Product Marketing, Paid Digital, Content, and Creative teams, you will leverage advanced AI tools and pragmatic marketing frameworks to solve complex pipeline challenges and fuel top-line revenue growth.</p>
<h3>Your Impact</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Drive Strategic Pipeline Growth:</strong> Conceptualize, build, and optimize targeted, multi-channel B2B marketing programs, campaigns, and high-touch ABM initiatives designed to generate and accelerate enterprise pipeline and bookings.</li>
<li><strong>Lead Events &amp; Field Marketing:</strong> Oversee Wrike’s event portfolio—including our flagship <em>Collaborate</em> conference, high-touch networking events, and key industry trade shows—ensuring seamless integration with sales follow-up strategies to nurture leads into closed-won business.</li>
<li><strong>Sales &amp; Executive Alignment:</strong> Partner cross-functionally with VPs of Sales and Sales Development to create tailored, vertical-specific campaigns and account-level strategies that maximize pipeline ROI.</li>
<li><strong>Measurement &amp; Optimization:</strong> Establish and maintain a continuous campaign measurement framework. Define campaign-level KPIs, optimize demand gen funnel performance, and enforce best-practice lead lifecycle and follow-up standards across teams.</li>
<li><strong>AI &amp; Workflow Innovation:</strong> Drive operational efficiency across your team by leveraging Wrike’s core workflows and implementing cutting-edge AI tools to scale campaign execution, enhance personalization, and optimize demand gen strategies.</li>
<li><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Development:</strong> Lead, mentor, and elevate a high-performing, self-sufficient team spanning Demand Generation, ABM, and Events, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Your Qualifications</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years of progressive B2B demand generation and growth marketing leadership experience at a SaaS organization.</li>
<li><strong>Domain &amp; Funnel Expertise:</strong> Deep expertise in key demand generation concepts: buyer’s journey mapping, lead management frameworks, pipeline acceleration, and pragmatic marketing methodologies.</li>
<li><strong>Omnichannel Mastery:</strong> Proven track record running life-cycle marketing, email marketing, webinars, digital marketing, content syndication, and enterprise integrated campaign strategies.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic &amp; Executional Balance:</strong> Demonstrated ability to operate seamlessly at a 2–3 year strategic horizon while remaining grounded in execution and campaign details.</li>
<li><strong>Sales Collaboration:</strong> Track record of successful strategic alignment with enterprise sales leaders, field teams, and executive stakeholders to drive revenue.</li>
<li><strong>Analytical Skills:</strong> Mastery of marketing automation platforms (Marketo, Eloqua, Pardot), CRM tools, and demand gen measurement frameworks.</li>
<li><strong>Intent-Based Marketing:</strong> Familiarity with 6sense and its application to account prioritization, audience targeting, and integrated campaigns.</li>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> BA/BS degree or equivalent professional experience.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Standout Qualities</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Enterprise Focus:</strong> Experience marketing to complex enterprise buying committees (Marketing, PMO, Professional Services, and IT).</li>
<li><strong>High-Touch ABM &amp; Events Experience:</strong> Proven history of building tailored, high-touch ABM campaigns and managing high-impact corporate/field events that deliver measurable pipeline ROI.</li>
<li><strong>AI &amp; Automation Trailblazer:</strong> Hands-on experience identifying and adopting advanced AI tools and automated workflows to accelerate marketing productivity and scale demand programs.</li>
<li><strong>Leadership Excellence:</strong> A passion for coaching and developing marketing talent, building succession pipelines, and fostering an inclusive, high-performance team culture.</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We're transforming the grocery industry</strong></p>
<p><span class="im">At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.</span></p>
<p>Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.</p>
<p><strong>Instacart is a Flex First team </strong></p>
<p>There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. <a href="https://www.instacart.careers/flex-first">Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.</a></p></div><p><strong>WHY THIS ROLE IS ON THE MENU</strong></p>
<p>Instacart's Commercial Analytics team sits at the intersection of the industry's richest grocery data, our most strategic retail partnerships, and the CPG category intelligence that powers growth across the platform. As our retailer relationships scale and the complexity of our business deepens, we need someone who can support the data and analytics layer for the entire Commercial organization. We're hiring a Business Intelligence Manager II to build the data and AI foundation the Commercial org runs on: the models, semantic layer, dashboards, and AI tools that let analysts go deeper and let partner managers get trusted answers. This individual contributor role is the first hire in a new Data &amp; AI function for Commercial Partnerships, with room to grow as it scales. The role will partner closely with our Commercial Insights and Partnerships teams, and the work will shape how Instacart grows its most important partnerships.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL COOK UP IN YOUR FIRST YEAR</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Analysts move faster because of your foundation. Core 1P and 3P data is modeled, tested, and documented. You work with Data Engineering to maintain and extend our retail data layer, so analysts spend their time on insight, not on reconciling numbers.</li>
<li>Third-party data is a trusted asset. You manage our 3P data partnerships and maintain source-of-truth documentation and examples, so technical teams across the company use it consistently.</li>
<li>Non-technical stakeholders self-serve. Partner Managers and Strategy &amp; Planning stakeholders get accurate answers through dashboards and AI tools built on the semantic layer, with the guardrails and evals that make them trustworthy. You know your users, built what they actually use, and can show adoption.</li>
<li>Repeat requests become products. You've turned recurring asks into self-serve tools, and you can show the hours saved or the requests that stopped coming.</li>
<li>Cross-functional teams are better equipped to answer "why" and "what's next." You've built tools and frameworks that help stakeholders move from raw data to clear direction.</li>
<li>You're the go-to expert on commercial data. Teams rely on you for where data comes from, what it means, and its caveats, including first- and third-party sources.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>THE SECRET INGREDIENTS WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>You sit between data and the business. You're as comfortable modeling data as you are sitting with an account manager to understand what they actually need, and you measure success by how many people can answer their own questions because of what you built.</p>
<p><strong>Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or analytics engineering, building data products (models, dashboards, and self-serve tools) for business stakeholders.</li>
<li>Strong SQL and solid data modeling fundamentals: choosing the right grain, designing fact and dimension tables, and handling data that changes over time.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with a modern data stack (e.g. dbt, Snowflake, Airflow).</li>
<li>Experience with modern BI platforms and a track record of building reliable, effective tools and dashboards.</li>
<li>Hands-on use of LLMs or AI tools in data workflows.</li>
<li>Strong communication and stakeholder management. You turn ambiguous business questions into data requirements, explain data caveats to non-technical audiences, and reshape requests when needed.</li>
<li>A self-starter orientation — you don't wait to be handed a problem; you identify it, frame it, and drive toward an answer.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in retail, e-commerce, or grocery — familiarity with the dynamics of online marketplaces is a meaningful accelerant.</li>
<li>Experience partnering with sales, account management, or partnerships teams.</li>
<li>Experience managing data from external vendors or third-party providers.</li>
<li>Experience with semantic data layers or metric frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience building AI data agents or LLM apps, including evaluation and guardrails.</li>
</ul>

</description></item><item><title>Upstart: Director of Privacy & Data Governance Risk</title><region>Anywhere in the World</region><country></country><state></state><category>All Other Remote</category><type>Full-Time</type><skills></skills><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 06:02:51 +0000</pubDate><link>https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upstart-director-of-privacy-data-governance-risk</link><guid>https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upstart-director-of-privacy-data-governance-risk</guid><description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States | Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Upstart</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.</p>
<p>As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.</p>
<p>We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.</p>
<p>If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.</p></div><p><strong>The Team: </strong></p>
<p>Upstart Bank’s Technology Team builds the technology foundation that enables the bank to operate securely, reliably, and at scale. Its scope includes infrastructure, core-banking integration, security, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), and identity management. The team’s squads focus on data and reporting, reconciliation, bank core systems, operating infrastructure, Upstart platform integrations, and consumer products.</p>
<p>As the <strong>Director of Privacy and Data Governance Risk</strong> at Upstart, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the responsible use of data across the organization. You will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive Privacy and Data Governance Risk Management Program ("the Program") that supports Upstart's mission while aligning with regulatory expectations and industry best practices. This role requires strong cross-functional leadership, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of privacy frameworks, regulatory requirements, and data governance principles. You will work closely with teams across Legal, Compliance, Product, Data Platform, AI/ML, and Information Security to identify, assess, and mitigate privacy and data governance risks across Upstart's products and services.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Define and drive the strategy for privacy and data governance risk management aligned with Upstart's business objectives and regulatory obligations.</li>
<li>Oversee the development of policies, procedures, and processes for data lifecycle management and privacy-by-design.</li>
<li>Serve as a strategic partner to Product, Data Platform, Information Security and other teams to embed privacy and data governance into product design, business operations, and third-party relationships, including vendor onboarding and renewals and data residency considerations.</li>
<li>Lead cross-functional working group to ensure governance, accountability, and continuous improvement in privacy risk management.</li>
<li>Lead a team responsible for the execution of privacy and data governance initiatives, with dotted-line oversight of Privacy Engineering.</li>
<li>Set team objectives and key results (OKRs), manage performance, and allocate resources effectively to deliver measurable impact.</li>
<li>Bring clear recommendations, with risks and trade-offs, to senior leaders across the business, driving issues to resolution.</li>
<li>Act as a spokesperson and subject matter expert for the Privacy and Data Governance &nbsp;Program in engagements with internal stakeholders and Upstart's partners.</li>
<li>Prepare and deliver communications, reports, and updates to senior leadership, regulatory bodies, and key external stakeholders as required.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of experience in compliance, legal, audit, or risk management within the financial services or fintech industry, with deep expertise in consumer protection regulations. This includes working knowledge of key regulatory frameworks such as GLBA, CCPA, FCRA, UDAAP, federal and state privacy laws, and emerging AI regulations.</li>
<li>3–5 years of risk or compliance governance experience at a financial institution, with demonstrated success in scaling frameworks and driving cross-functional alignment.</li>
<li>Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide risk and compliance programs, influence across levels and functions, and manage complex stakeholder environments.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in operationalizing risk management programs, including risk identification, control design, testing and monitoring, training and enablement, and oversight of third-party relationships.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with how predictive models and AI/ML systems use data, and the governance, privacy, and fairness risks that come with them.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with consent and data loss prevention tools such as DataGrail and Sentra, and with vendor and contract privacy review.</li>
<li>Strong people leadership experience, with a track record of building, managing, and developing high-performing teams.</li>
<li>Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex risk issues into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences.</li>
<li>Current and active certification in Privacy or Information Security (CISA, CISM, CISSP, CIPP, CIPM).</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Position location</strong> This role is available in the following locations: Remote</p>
<p><strong>Time zone requirements</strong> The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.</p>
<p><strong>Travel requirements</strong> As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.</p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></p>

<div></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span>At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.&nbsp; The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>The Business Development team at Pinterest is responsible for developing partner strategy, as well as sourcing, evaluating, executing and managing partnerships that are a critical lever for growth and progress of the company against key strategic initiatives. The team works closely with senior leadership, product, marketing, legal and revenue teams to deliver these partnerships.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The Business Development Lead for AI Partnerships will source and evaluate new partnerships and manage existing strategic partnerships with strategic technology platform companies to help drive growth and engagement on Pinterest.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead partner strategy, business development, and partner management for AI at Pinterest</li>
<li>Actively monitor, synthesize, inform, and action the industry landscape to identify opportunities</li>
<li>Lead the process of identifying partnerships to pursue, including building the business case through strategic/financial analysis and due diligence&nbsp;</li>
<li>Negotiate complex deals&nbsp;</li>
<li>Build relationships with leaders at emerging and established companies in the AI space</li>
<li>Coordinate deal execution and partner management across relevant teams including product, engineering, legal, and marketing</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent practical experience and 8+ years of work experience in business development with demonstrated experience leading complex deals&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience managing AI partnerships and/or a passion for the space</li>
<li>Strategic, driven, and analytical with a passion for consumer technology</li>
<li>Comfort in navigating the evolving technology landscape and leading through ambiguity</li>
<li>Experienced in performing broad quantitative analysis and negotiating complex deals</li>
<li>Ability to work effectively with cross-functional senior executives in a rapidly changing environment&nbsp;</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We're transforming the grocery industry</strong></p>
<p><span class="im">At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.</span></p>
<p>Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.</p>
<p><strong>Instacart is a Flex First team </strong></p>
<p>There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. <a href="https://www.instacart.careers/flex-first">Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.</a></p></div><p><strong>WHY THIS ROLE IS ON THE MENU</strong></p>
<p>Instacart's Commercial Analytics team sits at the intersection of the industry's richest grocery data, our most strategic retail partnerships, and the CPG category intelligence that powers growth across the platform. As our retailer relationships scale and the complexity of our business deepens, we need someone who can support the data and analytics layer for the entire Commercial organization. We're hiring a Business Intelligence Manager II to build the data and AI foundation the Commercial org runs on: the models, semantic layer, dashboards, and AI tools that let analysts go deeper and let partner managers get trusted answers. This individual contributor role is the first hire in a new Data &amp; AI function for Commercial Partnerships, with room to grow as it scales. The role will partner closely with our Commercial Insights and Partnerships teams, and the work will shape how Instacart grows its most important partnerships.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL COOK UP IN YOUR FIRST YEAR</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Analysts move faster because of your foundation. Core 1P and 3P data is modeled, tested, and documented. You work with Data Engineering to maintain and extend our retail data layer, so analysts spend their time on insight, not on reconciling numbers.</li>
<li>Third-party data is a trusted asset. You manage our 3P data partnerships and maintain source-of-truth documentation and examples, so technical teams across the company use it consistently.</li>
<li>Non-technical stakeholders self-serve. Partner Managers and Strategy &amp; Planning stakeholders get accurate answers through dashboards and AI tools built on the semantic layer, with the guardrails and evals that make them trustworthy. You know your users, built what they actually use, and can show adoption.</li>
<li>Repeat requests become products. You've turned recurring asks into self-serve tools, and you can show the hours saved or the requests that stopped coming.</li>
<li>Cross-functional teams are better equipped to answer "why" and "what's next." You've built tools and frameworks that help stakeholders move from raw data to clear direction.</li>
<li>You're the go-to expert on commercial data. Teams rely on you for where data comes from, what it means, and its caveats, including first- and third-party sources.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>THE SECRET INGREDIENTS WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>You sit between data and the business. You're as comfortable modeling data as you are sitting with an account manager to understand what they actually need, and you measure success by how many people can answer their own questions because of what you built.</p>
<p><strong>Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or analytics engineering, building data products (models, dashboards, and self-serve tools) for business stakeholders.</li>
<li>Strong SQL and solid data modeling fundamentals: choosing the right grain, designing fact and dimension tables, and handling data that changes over time.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with a modern data stack (e.g. dbt, Snowflake, Airflow).</li>
<li>Experience with modern BI platforms and a track record of building reliable, effective tools and dashboards.</li>
<li>Hands-on use of LLMs or AI tools in data workflows.</li>
<li>Strong communication and stakeholder management. You turn ambiguous business questions into data requirements, explain data caveats to non-technical audiences, and reshape requests when needed.</li>
<li>A self-starter orientation — you don't wait to be handed a problem; you identify it, frame it, and drive toward an answer.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in retail, e-commerce, or grocery — familiarity with the dynamics of online marketplaces is a meaningful accelerant.</li>
<li>Experience partnering with sales, account management, or partnerships teams.</li>
<li>Experience managing data from external vendors or third-party providers.</li>
<li>Experience with semantic data layers or metric frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience building AI data agents or LLM apps, including evaluation and guardrails.</li>
</ul>

This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. <p>Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings <a href="https://instacart.careers/taste-of-instacart/">here</a>.</p>
