<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ping Identity:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. <div>
<p class="markdown-p">You'll own the strategy for ZoomInfo's person data, which is hundreds of millions of contact records used by more than 35,000 customers. We're moving from rule-based selection to AI agents that read the full evidence for each record, and you'll build the evaluation engine that decides whether their answers are good enough to publish. If you've shipped data pipelines and entity resolution at scale and use AI every day to improve data systems, you'll help define how we prove the new system is right.</p>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">Own Person Data end to end, setting the strategy, roadmap, and monthly priorities for the accuracy, coverage, freshness, and compliance of contact data.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Build and run the AI evaluation engine: define "correct" for each attribute, curate golden sets and trap records, stand up LLM-as-judge gates, and set confidence thresholds that route records to auto-accept, auto-reject, or human review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Drive the pivot from rules to agents by moving person attributes from deterministic selection to inference over full evidence, proving each step in shadow mode, and retiring legacy logic when the numbers support it.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Introduce models where they earn their place and keep classical tooling where it wins, weighing cost per row, latency, determinism, and auditability.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Solve entity resolution challenges, including person-to-company matching, wrong-company links, and duplicate people.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Own the person data privacy roadmap (suppression, opt-out, and notification) in partnership with Legal and Privacy.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Prototype adjudication agents, evals, and analyses in code alongside the AI engineer and data science team, and commit to the shared repository.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Partner across Person Data engineering, Match, Research, Data Science, Privacy, and application teams, and present the roadmap and its rationale to product and data leadership.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You Bring</strong></p>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Must-Have</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning data products or data platforms at scale</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ideally incremental or streaming rather than batch rebuilds, and a working understanding of how records move from ingestion to a served dataset</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Direct experience with entity resolution, record linkage, or matching systems, including canonical IDs, match confidence, survivorship rules, and precision/recall trade-offs</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Current, demonstrated use of AI to improve data systems, including bringing an LLM into a production data process while keeping accuracy from degrading</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Experience designing evaluations for model output, including golden sets, precision and recall, LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop routing, and production drift monitoring</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Preferred</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">Experience with contact, person, or identity data, or with B2B company data</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Familiarity with privacy regulation for published personal data (GDPR, CCPA, DNC, and international notification regimes)</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Experience with Claude or comparable frontier models, agent frameworks, and eval harnesses</li>
<li class="markdown-li">Background at an AI research lab or an AI-native data company</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-Hybrid #LI-JS1</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, United States; San Mateo, CA; Toronto, Canada

<div class="job-post-container">

<div class="job-post-content">
<h1><img src="https://res.cloudinary.com/o2bwt8ar/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/CockroachLabs_Symbol_Black_2" alt="" width="92"></h1>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1>Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1>
<p>For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed. &nbsp;</p>
<p>At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity. &nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<h2><span><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Storage Team to help shape and build CockroachDB’s storage systems. Storage is the foundation of CockroachDB, responsible for the safe, durable and efficient persistence and retrieval of data, on top of which the rest of the database is built. Our team develops and maintains <a href="https://www.cockroachlabs.com/blog/pebble-rocksdb-kv-store/">Pebble</a>, an innovative Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree storage engine purpose built for Multi Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) data, and <a href="https://www.cockroachlabs.com/blog/continuum-architecture/#Cockroach-Plenum:-Disaggregated-Storage-for-Elastic-Infrastructure">Plenum</a>, the elastic, disaggregated storage layer that separates a cluster’s storage from its compute and allows them to scale independently.&nbsp;</p>
<p>In this role, you’ll bring deep storage expertise to complex problems spanning Pebble, Plenum, encryption at rest (EAR), CockroachDB’s storage interfaces, and the cloud environments in which they operate. You’ll work hands-on, lead the design and delivery of significant improvements, and help the team make sound tradeoffs among durability, performance, scalability, cost, and operational simplicity.</p>
<h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Work on hard technical problems.</strong> Apply your deep knowledge of storage systems to solve technical challenges at the core of CockroachDB and its storage layers.</li>
<li><strong>Lead through collaboration.</strong> Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify, design, and drive significant Storage initiatives, making tradeoffs clear and building alignment across involved teams.</li>
<li><strong>Be a trusted partner across the company.</strong> Work closely and collaboratively with other engineers across the database and cloud organizations, product, support, and field engineering.</li>
<li><strong>Set the standard for engineering excellence.</strong> Raise the effectiveness of the team through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Help the team leverage AI to produce high-quality software in a modern development environment.</li>
<li><strong>Ship mission-critical software.</strong> Ensure that CockroachDB remains scalable, survivable, and consistent as we continue to grow as a company. We work in Go and Rust, but if you don't know them, you'll learn while you're here.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2>
<p>In your first 30 days, you will establish relationships with the Storage team and learn about the Storage team’s domain and CockroachDB architecture. You will ship your first project.</p>
<p>After 3 months, you will be fully integrated into the team and comfortable contributing to the Storage team’s roadmap in partnership with Product. You’ll have built an understanding of the Storage team’s tech stack and feel comfortable with the architecture and components the team develops and maintains.</p>
<p>After 6 months, you will have led a meaningful piece of Storage work and participate in the Storage oncall rotation.</p>
<h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Deep systems experience</strong>. 8+ years building complex distributed systems or storage software, including significant time working on distributed systems, concurrency control, file systems, data replication, I/O performance, or memory management.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Storage architecture expertise</strong>. You have built or evolved a storage system such as log-structured merge-trees, blob storage, or cloud object storage.</li>
<li><strong>Production experience.</strong> Experience building, running, and debugging large-scale distributed systems in production and evolving systems through rolling upgrades.</li>
<li><strong>A collaborative approach.</strong> You have a passion for solving hard technical problems with others, sharing context, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback, and helping teammates succeed. You enjoy mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on ability.</strong> You write production-ready code in systems programming languages like Go, Rust, or C/C++. You dig into hard bugs, profiles, and incidents when it matters.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Rachael Harding - Manager, Engineering</strong></p>
<p>Rachael leads the Storage team within the Database Engineering organization, where she oversees the development of Pebble and Plenum. Based in the Bay Area with her family, Rachael enjoys sampling pastries, exploring local parks, and baking with her kids.</p>
<p><strong>Nick Travers - Director, Engineering</strong></p>
<p>Nick joined Cockroach Labs in 2021 and leads Database Engineering - the group of teams building CockroachDB. Originally from Perth, Australia, he lives in Los Angeles with his family. Arsenal supporter, cook, outdoors person.</p>
<p><strong>Isaac Wong - EVP of Research &amp; Development</strong></p>
<p>Isaac is responsible for the health of the engineering organization at Cockroach Labs. He partners closely with teams to ensure we have a balanced culture that promotes quality and innovation in pursuit of our goals. Before joining Cockroach Labs Isaac was in life sciences for 16 years with Medidata Solutions where he had a front row seat on the exciting ride from a 30 person startup to more than 2000 people worldwide. But the lure of distributed, resilient, and consistent SQL databases, along with the amazing technology and culture at Cockroach Labs proved too much. When not working he likes to draw, play the piano, and search NYC for cannoli's with his wife and kids.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p>
<p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p>

In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p>
<p>The People Analytics &amp; Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity &amp; Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.</p>
<p><span><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze</li>
<li>Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others</li>
<li>Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business</li>
<li>Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders</li>
<li>Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards</li>
<li>Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting</li>
<li>Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb</li>
<li>Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver</li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field</li>
<li>Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis</li>
<li>Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access</li>
<li>Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit</li>
<li>Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data</li>
<li>Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact</li>
<li>Experience working with large practical datasets</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2>
<p>The Data team builds and runs the systems that make Stability AI's data usable, both to operate the business and to train our models. We're a small, collaborative team that works closely with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research. We focus on outcomes rather than hours, and you'll have deep technical access and the freedom to build.</p>
<p><strong>Our stack:</strong> AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, EMR, Step Functions, EventBridge), Iceberg, dbt, Postgres, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, QuickSight, Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, Customer.io, PostHog, OpenTelemetry and SLURM — or similar. We care about the judgement more than the logo.</p>
<h2><strong>The Work</strong></h2>
<p>You'll own our company data platform end to end: the AWS data lake, the transformation layer, the integrations between our business systems, and the Kubernetes-based infrastructure they run on. The data that runs the business (billing, usage telemetry, identity, CRM, ERP, cloud cost) lives in a dozen systems that were never wired together. You'll be the engineer who connects them and keeps them reliable.</p>
<p>You'll also be the data engineer for our research teams across audio, video, image and 3D, building the pipelines that turn raw media into training-ready datasets. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, not a data-prep or analyst seat.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own</strong> the company data platform end to end: the S3/Athena/Glue lake, the dbt project and its daily build, ingestion from Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, OpenTelemetry and product events, and the Postgres serving layer for dashboards and AI agents</li>
<li><strong>Build and operate</strong> integrations between billing, CRM, ERP, identity and telemetry systems so revenue, usage, cost and customer identity reconcile automatically instead of through spreadsheets and tickets</li>
<li><strong>Design and maintain</strong> the warehouse layer: dimensional models, data contracts with product engineering for event schemas, quality tests, lineage and a catalog</li>
<li><strong>Enforce</strong> PII tiering (open vs. restricted schemas) through access grants, working with Security and Legal</li>
<li><strong>Process</strong> data at scale: billions of telemetry rows, terabyte log streams, Iceberg tables, partitioning and cost control</li>
<li><strong>Own</strong> orchestration and infrastructure: orchestration on EKS, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and join the business-hours on-call rotation for the daily pipelines</li>
<li><strong>Deliver</strong> operational reporting for Finance and leadership: revenue by business line, credits and prepaid liability, and cloud cost by department</li>
<li><strong>Support</strong> the research teams across every modality: source, license-check, ingest and version large training datasets for audio, video, image and 3D</li>
<li><strong>Build</strong> the generation, filtering, deduplication and captioning pipelines that turn raw or synthetic media into training-ready shards, and run them at scale on our SLURM cluster and cloud object storage</li>
<li><strong>Keep</strong> lineage, quality metrics and dataset documentation current so any researcher can reproduce a training set</li>
<li><strong>Lead</strong> design reviews, mentor teammates and write the runbooks that remove single-person dependencies</li>
<li><strong>Partner</strong> with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research on company-wide data initiatives</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2>
<p>We're looking for an engineer who pairs strong software engineering habits with warehouse. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering habits with warehouse modelling depth, and the judgement to say what a number means and what it does not.</p>
<h3><strong>Experience</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>6+ years building and running production data platforms, including ownership of the architecture</li>
<li>Experience integrating SaaS business systems (Stripe, HubSpot, an ERP, an identity provider) into a warehouse</li>
<li>Production experience preparing large multimodal training datasets and running batch workloads on HPC or cloud schedulers (SLURM, Kubernetes or similar)</li>
<li>Comfort working independently in a small team with real ownership</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Skills &amp; Expertise</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Expert SQL and Python, with strong software engineering habits: tests, code review and CI</li>
<li>Warehouse and lake experience with real modelling: Iceberg or Delta on S3, Athena/Trino, Snowflake or BigQuery, and dbt</li>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3><strong>About the Role:</strong></h3>
<p>As a CloudOps Engineer at Wrike, you have advanced skills in supporting cloud and on-prem data center infrastructure with security in mind. You know how to work with containers, networking, monitoring, automation, and debugging a reasonably complex infrastructure. You feel comfortable defining your own work based on the team OKRs. You can also help others do so when necessary. You are used to proposing meaningful improvements to the existing infrastructure in alignment with architects and tech leads, and you can drive the execution</p>
<p>In this specific role, you will take ownership of the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our <strong>Network Infrastructure</strong> across hybrid environments. You bring deep, hands-on expertise in architecting resilient network topologies, configuring core routing and switching, managing firewalls, and securing connectivity between cloud providers and on-premise data centers.</p>
<h3>Your Impact:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>Keep our infrastructure and company information safe with reliable network security</li>
<li>Keep our services running smoothly and fast for users around the clock</li>
<li>Managing the Wrike product infrastructure</li>
<li>Implementing reliable solutions to ensure a product uptime SLA of 99.9%</li>
<li>Working with GCP, AWS and other cloud providers in the IaC paradigm</li>
<li>Introducing and supporting new infrastructure services</li>
<li>Actively participating in incident response and management, including on-call duties</li>
<li>Developing and maintaining professional connections within and outside of the team</li>
</ul>
<h3>Your Qualifications:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>Juniper/Cisco devices underlying network infra</li>
<li>Kubernetes and ArgoCD</li>
<li>Nginx, HAproxy and Istio for load balancing</li>
<li>GCP, AWS and Cloudflare are our main cloud providers</li>
<li>Puppet, Ansible and Terraform for defining everything as a code</li>
<li>Python to automate everything</li>
<li>Prometheus (VictoriaMetrics) and Zabbix for monitoring</li>
<li>Graylog, Logstash, Fluentd for logging</li>
<li>Jenkins and Gitlab-CI for building pipelines</li>
<li>Upper Intermediate English skills</li>
</ul>
<h3>Standout Qualities:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience with working with enterprise-grade infrastructure and SaaS solutions</li>
<li>Profound knowledge of network technologies, data transmission protocols, network architecture, and equipment</li>
<li>Experience working with BGP, OSPF, EVPN, STP, IPsec protocols</li>
<li>Familiarity with Linux, iptables, Nginx, HAproxy, and keepalive</li>
<li>Understanding of information security principles and the ability to apply them to network architecture</li>
<li>Sufficient scripting skills in Python/Bash or other scripting languages</li>
<li>Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills</li>
</ul>
<h3>Team Dynamics:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>Your manager will be Dmitrii Vlasov, SysOps Team Lead&nbsp;</li>
<li>We have two dozen folks in the SysOps Department, consisting of four teams distributed in Prague, Nicosia, Rennes and Tallinn</li>

<li>Scrum based processes (daily standups, biweekly plannings, quarterly plannings)</li>
<li>Hybrid mode (1-2 days per week)</li>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform:&nbsp;<strong>play video games.</strong>&nbsp;Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p>
<p>The Safety Platform team is at the heart of keeping Discord safe for all users. We provide the infrastructure and services that enable scalable and reliable safety on Discord. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who will be a technical leader and force multiplier for the Safety Platform team. You'll autonomously deliver high-impact projects that are often ambiguous and open-ended, while setting the technical direction for safety systems that protect millions of users daily.</p>
<p>As a Staff Engineer on Safety Platform, you'll not only be a top code contributor but also help the entire team level up through technical mentorship, architectural guidance, and fostering a culture of excellence. You'll embrace an "all problems are my problem" mindset, helping teammates overcome obstacles while maintaining Discord's high quality bar.</p>
<h3><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Serve as a technical lead and mentor, guiding ICs through design, experimentation, and implementation while raising the technical bar</li>
<li>Define and drive Safety Platform’s technical strategy and roadmap</li>
<li>Set the bar in technical reviews, including code, design, and architecture, ensuring the team builds scalable, robust, and high-quality systems</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data science, policy, legal, and engineering partners to align on safety goals and deliver effective solutions</li>
<li>Tackle the most complex and high-impact challenges in safety, including adversarial abuse, harmful content detection, and evolving threat vectors</li>
<li>Influence the company’s direction on safety, clearly communicating trade-offs and technical constraints to senior leadership and stakeholders</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you should have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of professional experience in an infrastructure focused software development role</li>
<li>Strong programming skills&nbsp;in languages like Python, Rust, Typescript</li>
<li>Experience designing and deploying scalable services using components such as PubSub, GCP/AWS, and Kubernetes</li>
<li>Experience with large-scale distributed systems&nbsp;serving millions of users, including deployment tools and infrastructure automations like Terraform</li>
<li>Experience leading projects on cross-team and company-wide scale</li>
<li>Experience scaling and migrating systems with little to no downtime</li>
<li>Experience mentoring engineers at various stages in their careers</li>
<li>Experience driving a culture of operational excellence, with a deep understanding of metrics, alerts, and dashboards</li>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.</p>
<p>Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.</li>
<li>Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.</li>
<li>Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.</li>
<li>Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.</li>
<li>Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You Should Have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.</li>
<li>Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.</li>
<li>Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.</li>
<li>Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.</li>
<li>A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.</li>
<li>Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.</li>
</ul>

<li>Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.</li>
<li>Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.</li>

<p>

</p>

<p><em>Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.</em></p>
<p><em>We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.</em></p>
<hr>
<p><strong>About the Role:</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Developer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a new quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. You will work in an environment that promotes ownership at all levels including configuring and monitoring apps in production.<br><br><strong><em>This is a fully remote position to candidates who are based in Canada.</em></strong><strong><em><br></em></strong><strong><em><br></em></strong><strong>Our Core Technologies Include:</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>Java, Selenium Webdriver, Playwright, Claude Code, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, REST Assured, OkHttp, SumoLogic, Docker, Kubernetes, Gatling, Linux etc<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do:&nbsp;</strong></p>

<li>Develop test automation at the pace of feature development utilizing AI tools and our functional and performance test frameworks</li>
<li>Utilize LLMs to create feature test plans and internal knowledge stores for streamlining AI tools usage for Automation and Deep testing efforts</li>

<li>Customize, configure, patch services, and deploy infrastructure and code changes all the way through to production</li>

<li>Familiarity with log aggregators such as SumoLogic or Kibana, and app monitoring tools such as Honeycomb or Grafana</li>
<li>Passion for automating tests and delivering high quality features in a fast paced environment</li>

<p><br><strong>What We Offer You:&nbsp;</strong></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote
</p>

<p>Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.</p>
<p>Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.</p>
<p>Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.</p>
<h2>The opportunity</h2>
<p>As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.</p>
<p>You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.</li>
<li>Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.</li>
<li>Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.</li>
<li>Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.</li>
<li>Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.</li>
<li>Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.</li>
<li>Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.</li>
<li>Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.</li>
<li>Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.</li>
<li>Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.</li>
<li>Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What success looks like</h2>
<p>We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:</p>
<ul>
<li>Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.</li>
<li>Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.</li>
<li>The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.</li>
<li>Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.</li>
<li>Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What we’re looking for</h2>
<ul>
<li>Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.</li>
<li>A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.</li>
<li>Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.</li>
<li>Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.</li>
<li>Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.</li>
<li>A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.</li>
<li>The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.</li>
<li>A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.</li>
<li>Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Salary: $200,000 - $260,000k/yr + variable</strong></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> -REMOTE, USA-

<div class="content-intro"><p>For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.</p></div><p>Smartsheet is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Field Systems team, the group responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling the commercial go-to market tools including CRM, e-signature, opportunity management, sales engagement, marketing automation, and forecasting platforms. You will own the product roadmap and serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and an agile delivery team to ensure the right work gets prioritized, scoped, and shipped at the right time.</p>
<p>This is a high-impact role at the intersection of enterprise systems, business strategy, and Scaled agile execution. You'll thrive here if you love translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, leveraging modern AI tools to work smarter and faster, and partnering closely with sales, marketing, finance, and customer success to drive measurable outcomes.</p>
<p>You will report to our Director, Field Systems. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.</p>
<p><strong>You Will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with the Director of Field Systems to define, maintain, and communicate a prioritized product roadmap aligned to company go-to-market objectives</li>
<li>Continuously assess the value, urgency, and feasibility of roadmap initiatives to ensure the team is always working on the highest-impact problems</li>
<li>Translate strategic priorities into quarterly PI (Program Increment) objectives within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)</li>
<li>Engage directly with internal stakeholders including Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Technical Support to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and business goals</li>
<li>Define clear epics, features, and user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria.</li>
<li>Lead discovery activities including stakeholder interviews, process walkthroughs, and data analysis to inform solution design</li>
<li>Leverage AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to accelerate requirements documentation, synthesize stakeholder feedback, draft communications, and surface insights from data bringing a modern, AI-augmented approach to everyday PM work</li>
<li>Serve as the Product Owner for the agile team, owning and grooming the team backlog to ensure a healthy queue of well-refined work</li>
<li>Actively participate in SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Refinement, Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospectives, and System Demos</li>
<li>Make real-time prioritization and trade-off decisions to keep the team moving and unblocked</li>
<li>Maintain transparent, proactive communication with stakeholders on roadmap status, delivery timelines, and change impacts</li>
<li>Build trust with business partners by consistently delivering on commitments and surfacing risks early</li>
<li>Collaborate with change management and enablement teams to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities</li>
<li>Define success metrics for features and initiatives; track outcomes post-deployment and use data to inform future prioritization</li>
<li>Drive retrospective insights from delivery into roadmap refinement and team process improvements</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You Have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on go-to market tools and platform products in an enterprise environment</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience working within SAFe or agile framework, including PI Planning and cross-team coordination</li>
<li>Strong product sense with experience balancing user needs, business value, and technical feasibility</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present confidently to senior leaders and technical teams alike</li>
<li>Experience writing detailed epics and features, lean business cases, and user stories with strong assumptions and acceptance criteria</li>
<li>Comfort with data including the ability to query data, interpret metrics, and build business cases</li>
<li>Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification</li>
<li>Experience supporting sales operations, revenue operations, or marketing operations functions</li>
<li>Familiarity with CPQ, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud implementations</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) applied to PM workflows such as documentation, research, or analysis.</li>
<li>SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification</li>
<li>Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Current US Perks &amp; Benefits:</strong></p>

<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong><br><br>We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team. <li><span>Experience using AI development tools while independently validating generated code.</span></li>

<li><span>Ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.</span></li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US- Remote
</p>

<p>Since inception, Elation has been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through our SaaS cloud-based clinical platform.</p>
<p>As we continue to scale, we are growing our Customer Success organization to meet the needs of our most strategic customers. We are seeking an experienced, senior-level Customer Success Manager to own and grow a portfolio of innovative healthcare delivery organizations.</p>
<h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Strategic Account Ownership</strong> Serve as the trusted strategic advisor and primary point of contact for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise healthcare customers. Build deep executive relationships, understand each organization's clinical and operational goals, and position Elation as a long-term platform partner.</p>
<p><strong>Strategic Account Planning</strong> Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-stakeholder account plans aligned to each customer's business objectives. Drive measurable platform adoption, value realization, and long-term partnership growth.</p>
<p><strong>Executive Engagement &amp; Value Delivery</strong> Lead high-impact Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) with senior clinical and operational leadership. Deliver data-driven ROI narratives and strategic roadmaps that reinforce Elation's value and deepen executive sponsorship.</p>
<p><strong>Renewal Management</strong> Own the full renewal lifecycle — from strategic planning and executive alignment to contract negotiation and timely close. Maintain a strong, predictable renewal rate across your book of business.</p>
<p><strong>Strategic Expansion &amp; Whitespace Management</strong> Act as the primary commercial lead for your portfolio, directly driving and executing the end-to-end sales cycle for all cross-sell and upsell transactions. You will proactively pursue and close whitespace opportunities by translating usage data, clinical workflows, and organizational growth signals into prioritized expansion strategies that result in realized revenue and increased account penetration.</p>
<p><strong>Proactive Risk Mitigation</strong> Monitor customer health signals and leverage AI-driven insights to identify at-risk accounts early. Develop and execute tailored mitigation plans to address risk and protect long-term retention.</p>
<p><strong>Product Adoption &amp; Utilization</strong> Drive deep feature adoption across your portfolio through targeted campaigns and high-impact interventions. Partner with product and clinical teams to ensure customers are maximizing the full value of the Elation platform.</p>
<p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong> Partner closely with Implementation, Professional Services, Sales, and Technical Support to deliver a seamless, world-class customer journey from onboarding through renewal and beyond.</p>
<p><strong>Consultative Selling</strong> Act as a consultative partner — identifying evolving customer needs and effectively presenting the value of Elation Health's expanding suite of products and services.</p>
<h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Experience</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer-facing growth role, with at least 2+ years focused on mid-market and enterprise accounts in healthcare SaaS, EHR, or RCM platforms</li>
<li>Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and navigating large healthcare organizations</li>
<li>Prior experience owning expansion revenue, renewals, and upsell/cross-sell motions within an existing book of business</li>
<li>Familiarity with ambulatory, specialty, multi-site group practices, or enterprise health systems</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Skills &amp; Competencies</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Executive presence and the ability to influence and build trust with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders</li>
<li>Strong full-cycle, consultative selling instincts — comfortable identifying needs, building business cases, and presenting solutions</li>
<li>Proficiency in data storytelling: translating platform usage, outcomes data, and ROI metrics into compelling customer narratives</li>
<li>Skilled in clinical use case framing to connect platform capabilities to physician and operational workflows</li>
<li>Experience with lifecycle automation tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and customer health monitoring solutions</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Mindset</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Strategic thinker who balances long-term relationship building with near-term revenue accountability</li>
<li>Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing a complex book of business with competing priorities</li>
<li>Collaborative and cross-functional by nature — you thrive working with sales, product, and services teams</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How We Measure Success</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)</li>
<li>Expansion and upsell pipeline and close rate</li>
<li>Renewal rate and on-time renewal %</li>
<li>Platform adoption and utilization metrics across portfolio</li>
<li>Executive engagement and EBR completion rate</li>
<li>Proactive outreach and health score improvement across at-risk accounts</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Salary: $105,000 - 120,000/yr USD w/ variable comp</strong></p>

<p>We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.</p>

We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@<a class="c-link" href="http://tebra.com/">tebra.com</a>, @<a class="c-link" href="http://patientpop.com/">patientpop.com</a>, or @<a class="c-link" href="http://kareo.com/">kareo.com</a>) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.&nbsp;We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.</p></div><h1>About the Role</h1>
<p>Tebra is seeking a Senior Product Manager for our Patient Experience portfolio. You will help independent healthcare practices connect with patients and reduce administrative work. You will own product strategy and execution, turn customer needs into clear priorities, lead cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, and measure customer and business outcomes. You will bring practical AI fluency to both the products you build and the way you work. Scope may evolve across Patient Experience products, including calendar and scheduling capabilities, as customer needs and business priorities change.&nbsp;</p>
<h1>Your Area of Focus</h1>
<ul>
<li>Define and design features on one or more of Tebra’s core products that solve customer problems.</li>
<li>Drive Message Center forward as a core Patient Experience product, improving patient and practice communication while partnering with Engineering, Legal, and Operations on application-to-person (A2P) messaging compliance, registration, consent, and delivery reliability.</li>
<li>Identify where AI and automation can reduce practice staff effort or improve patient interactions. Use approved AI tools to synthesize research, explore solutions, build working prototypes, and test assumptions while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.</li>
<li>Partner with technical teams to define AI quality measures, representative evaluation cases, human review and fallback paths, and launch criteria. Balance usefulness and accuracy with privacy, latency, and cost.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Perform market research, including defining and analyzing customer segments, reviewing industry research reports, assessing strengths and weaknesses of competitors, determining needs of different specialties, and studying pricing and packaging options.</li>
<li>Collaborating cross-functionally to design features and processes for Tebra’s platform and customer experience.</li>
<li>Research product positioning and provide recommendations to Product Marketing.</li>
<li>Collecting feedback by reviewing customer support issues, administering user acceptance tests, reviewing sales win/loss data, and visiting customers to study product interaction in their natural environment.</li>
<li>Preparing software design plans including product specifications, use case documentation, and user interface wireframes.</li>
<li>Managing the customer experience roadmap, including documenting product strategy and owning the feature backlog.</li>
<li>Analyze and prepare product usage reports on key product features and provide recommendations for the product roadmap.</li>
<li>Stay current on industry-related regulatory and compliance requirements that pertain to healthcare technology.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Your Professional Qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>Must have 5+ years of experience in product, focused on software applications.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience using generative AI in product work, with examples of prototypes, experiments, or workflow improvements that helped a team learn or deliver faster. Experience shipping and evaluating an AI-powered product capability in production is preferred.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of large language models, prompting, retrieval, and agentic workflows, including their limitations. You can collaborate with technical partners on evaluations, human oversight, privacy, and responsible use.</li>
<li>Demonstrated success with customer-facing products, complex workflows, and product strategy, with the ability to understand patient and independent practice needs.</li>
<li>Proven track record as product manager at a successful B2B SaaS / Cloud software business with agile product management experience.</li>
<li>Proven track record of executing complex product initiatives and processes with multiple stakeholders at senior and junior levels.</li>
<li>Superior analytical and problem solving skills, with demonstrated analytical rigor, attention to detail, and the ability to structure and analyze sophisticated financial modeling.</li>
<li>A flexible and creative thinker with the ability to define business trade-offs, generate out-of-the-box solutions and move through ambiguity.</li>
<li>Prior experience developing products in the healthcare industry is preferred.</li>
</ul>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.</p>
<p>Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.</p>

<p>You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:</p>

</ul></div><p><strong>JOB SUMMARY</strong></p>
<p>Join Storyblok's Support team as a <strong>Technical Support Engineer II</strong>, where you'll excel in handling escalated tickets and troubleshooting intricate issues independently. <p>Your role extends beyond issue resolution; you'll manage cases from inception to resolution, prioritizing timely responses and exceeding customer expectations. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including tech support, sales, and partner account managers, you'll streamline processes and drive efficiency to enhance overall customer satisfaction.</p>
<p>Furthermore, your expertise will be pivotal in guiding product improvements and updates based on customer feedback. You'll actively contribute to identifying inefficiencies in support processes and suggesting enhancements to boost productivity and elevate the user experience.<br><br>To support more complex, high-impact customer scenarios, you may also engage customers directly via video calls to troubleshoot technical issues in real time and accelerate resolution, particularly in advanced or enterprise-level cases.</p>
<p>In addition to your technical prowess, you'll play a crucial role in mentoring and training Technical Support Engineer I, fostering their growth and development within the team. Join us at Storyblok, where your contributions will shape the future of our support ecosystem and directly impact our continued growth and success.</p>

<li>Manage cases throughout the entire support lifecycle from initial customer inquiry to triage and reproduction, writing bug reports for hand-off to the development team.</li>
<li>Meet or exceed customer expectations on response quality and SLA within our ticketing platform and live chat.</li>
<li>Educate customers on product features, functionalities, and best practices.</li>
<li>Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude in all customer interactions.</li>
<li>Collaborate with tech support, sales representatives, and partner account managers to resolve issues efficiently and effectively.</li>
<li>Contribute to identifying inefficiencies in support processes and suggest improvements to enhance productivity and customer satisfaction.</li>
<li>Assist in training the Technical Support Engineer I and provide mentorship as needed.</li>
<li>Handle customer escalations from Technical Support Engineer I, addressing concerns promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.</li>
<li>Participate in customer video calls when appropriate to troubleshoot complex technical issues live, helping reduce back-and-forth communication and speed up resolution for high-priority or advanced customer cases.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>&nbsp;</em></strong></p>
<p><strong>EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>3+ years of Support Engineering, Software Engineering experience.</li>
<li>Thorough knowledge with consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of at least one modern JavaScript framework such as Vue.js, React, Next.js, or Nuxt.js and their fundamental principles.<br><br></li>
<li>Ability to debug and troubleshoot applications built with modern JavaScript frameworks (required).</li>
<li>Thorough knowledge of JavaScript and its modern syntax and features. Experience with Typescript is a plus.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.</li>
<li>Experience with CMS in general; experience with Headless CMS is a plus.</li>
<li>Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.</li>
<li>Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues in real time with customers or internal stakeholders (e.g., via screen sharing or video calls) is a plus.</li>
<li>Remote working experience.</li>
<li>Well-organized, self-starting, has excellent work ethic, and pays attention to detail.</li>
<li>A proactive approach to day-to-day tasks while also going above and beyond with continuous improvement as a core driving principle.</li>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We're transforming the grocery industry</strong></p>
<p><span class="im">At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.</span></p>
<p>Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.</p>
<p><strong>Instacart is a Flex First team </strong></p>
<p>There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. <a href="https://www.instacart.careers/flex-first">Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.</a></p></div><h2><strong>Overview</strong></h2>
<p>The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist II with a strong quantitative background to join our team. In this role, you will apply your expertise in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About the Job</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with senior scientists, engineers and product managers to translate well-defined marketplace questions into mathematical formulations, implement analyses and prototypes, design experiments, and interpret results using large-scale data.</li>
<li>Contribute to production systems through algorithm implementation, validation, and monitoring, progressively taking ownership of well-scoped projects from initial hypothesis through measurable impact.</li>
<li>Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where the ads marketplace shifts quickly — you'll need to balance rigor with speed, and thrive when priorities change and new challenges emerge.</li>
<li>Communicate assumptions, findings, and limitations clearly to both technical and cross-functional partners, helping the team make better decisions through transparency and analytical clarity.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>Minimum Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>PhD in operations research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a strong foundation in at least one of the following areas: optimization, probability, statistical modeling, econometrics, or control theory.</li>
<li>Proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to translate quantitative concepts into analyses, algorithm implementations, and experiments.</li>
<li>Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Preferred Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in applying quantitative methods to production systems.</li>
<li>Familiarity with ads systems, auction theory, or related marketplace optimization problems.</li>
<li>Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and real-time decision systems.</li>
<li>Familiarity with machine learning techniques and applying machine learning in production systems.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy <a href="https://instacart.careers/flex-first/">here</a>. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.</p>
<p>Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings <a href="https://instacart.careers/taste-of-instacart/">here</a>.</p>
<p>For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.</p></div><div class="title">CAN</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$154,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$162,500 CAD</span></div></div></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.</p>
<p>Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU</strong></p>
<p>You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)</li>
<li>Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding</li>
<li>Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays</li>
<li>Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material</li>
<li>The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers</li>
<li>As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules</li>
<li>An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals</li>
</ul></div><p><strong>JOB SUMMARY</strong></p>
<p>Work with Storyblok’s dynamic legal team and play a vital role in our day-to-day operations in the EMEA region. The primary focus of this role is leading SaaS sales contract negotiations—drafting, redlining, and closing enterprise agreements that enable Storyblok’s EMEA sales team to move quickly and confidently. Beyond contracts, your responsibilities span advising on corporate, privacy, employment and labor law, and supporting product and cybersecurity compliance initiatives. You will lead legal projects with autonomy, guide business teams, and collaborate with external counsel as needed. While focused on the EMEA region, you will also support legal initiatives in AMER, contributing to global policies and aligning legal processes across regions. Additionally, you will provide legal training, empower team members to manage day-to-day legal tasks, and support the legal leadership in executing strategic priorities and continuous improvement efforts.</p>
<p>This role requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional teams across the company—with a particular emphasis on the Sales team—as well as Marketing, Partners, Product, People, etc., to provide practical, business-minded legal support .&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead the redlining &amp; negotiating process and own SaaS enterprise sales contracts as the primary focus of this role—including MSA, GTC/ToS, NDA, DPA, and other legal agreements—enabling the EMEA sales team to close deals efficiently and with legal confidence&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Advise on legal principles relating to data privacy, IP, information security, and corporate risk mitigation</li>
<li>Lead the review and negotiate partnership agreements with our partners in EMEA</li>
<li>Lead (globally) with review and negotiation of procurement and marketing contracts as needed&nbsp;</li>
<li>Lead HR related projects &amp; provide legal support for certain employment and labor law topics&nbsp;</li>
<li>Draft, review, and maintain company-wide policies in accordance with applicable legal requirements and organisational governance standards</li>
<li>Responsible for monitoring and assessing developments in applicable laws and regulations, advising the business on emerging legal risks and required adaptations to agreements, policies, or operational practices</li>
<li>&nbsp;Provide legal advice and lead from a legal side the new product initiatives &amp; feature launches</li>
<li>Initiate and lead comprehensive legal training to different teams (e.g. prepare and structure the information for training)</li>
<li>Independently lead and own the end-to-end delivery of cross-functional legal projects and improvement initiatives across multiple business regions, ensuring coherent alignment with applicable regulatory frameworks, local counsel, and key business stakeholders</li>
<li>Identity and lead the continuous improvement of legal processes, templates, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency and best practice adoption across the organisation</li>
<li>Support the legal team to build and maintain documentation for the whole team</li>
<li>Be responsible and contribute across a range of administrative functions and project-based work, adapting to evolving priorities and business needs</li>
<li>Provide accurate and concise legal research as needed&nbsp;</li>
<li>Drive and implement regional legal strategies to support the company’s growth and operations</li>
</ul>
<p><br><br><strong>EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Law Degree and Bar Admission to at least one jurisdiction in Europe</li>
<li>4+ years of experience with a primary focus on drafting, redlining, and negotiating sales contracts. SaaS or fast-paced tech experience providing in-house support to enterprise sales teams is strongly preferred.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Enterprise Sales teams to negotiate customer-facing commercial agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, Terms of Service, and related SaaS contracts.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of commercial contracting with deep expertise in sales contracts and legal processes</li>
<li>Broad and in-depth specialized knowledge of the EU legal framework plus some knowledge of the UK and/or U.S.&nbsp; law would be strongly preferred</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS &amp; COMPETENCIES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Excellent English language skills</li>
<li>Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of contracts under tight deadlines</li>
<li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders including sales, finance, HR, and product teams</li>
<li>Interested in learning fast and participating in a wide variety of legal projects&nbsp;</li>
<li>Skilled in providing concise legal advice to business teams</li>
<li>Ability to analyze the needs of different parties quickly and provide a creative solution</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of matters end-to-end, while operating effectively within a broader legal team structure</li>
<li>Understands and perform in complex legal and business processes</li>
<li>Good organizational skills &amp; well structured to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.</li>
<li>Takes initiative and brings a sense of accountability in the workplace - proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented</li>
<li>Overcomes challenges through teamwork, optimism, and just enough humor to keep things exciting (without compromising professionalism, of course)</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p>
<p><span>Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space</span></p>

<p>All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (<a class="c-link" href="http://storyblok.com/">storyblok.com</a>).</p>

  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> U.S. Remote
