<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2>
<p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h2><strong>The Opportunity:&nbsp;</strong></h2>
<p>Flexport IT is looking for a <strong>Senior IT Systems Engineer </strong>to support our SaaS based Collaboration and Endpoint Management platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for the configuration, integration, administration, and support of Google Workspace, Slack, Office365, Confluence, Jira, Okta, Jamf, and Intune. You will play a critical role in ensuring these platforms are secure, scalable, and optimized. The candidate will have broad knowledge across IT as a whole, in-depth hands on working knowledge, and a strong security mindset.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Your expertise will be critical in automating workflows, protecting sensitive systems and data, mitigating security risks, and maintaining compliance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, lead IT engineering projects, and provide day to day operations support.</p>
<h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Administer and provide escalation support for our SaaS platforms.</li>
<li>Implement and maintain policies, software deployment, patching, and security compliance for our Mac and Windows endpoints, using Jamf and Intune.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Own the lifecycle management across our core collaboration and endpoint management platforms.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Develop automation scripts and workflows to improve administrative efficiency and user experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Okta Workflows).</li>
<li>Monitor system health, performance, and usage; proactively resolve or escalate issues.</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security, Engineering, HR, Legal) to ensure proper alignment and integration of SaaS tools with company infrastructure and processes.</li>
<li>Perform investigations/discovery across our systems for Legal and HR.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Assist in vendor management and product evaluations.</li>
<li>Drive solutions and project work.</li>
<li>Onboard new applications for single sign-on.</li>
<li>Develop and maintain technical operating procedures, policies, and engineering roadmaps.</li>
<li>Work closely with the Security team to ensure the platform is designed and implemented with security best practices.</li>
<li>Provide Tier 3 IT support.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>You Should Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or comparable experience).</li>
<li>3+ years of experience in supporting SaaS Collaboration tools, Mac and Windows endpoint management.</li>
<li>Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.</li>
<li>In-depth knowledge of email delivery flow, IT security, and IAM concepts.</li>
<li>Understanding of RBAC and permissions models across core SaaS applications.</li>
<li>Scripting and automation experience.</li>
<li>Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.</li>
</ul>

  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Denver, Colorado, United States; Remote, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>About Checkr<br></strong></span>Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.<br><br>We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on <a href="https://www.forbes.com/lists/cloud100/">Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List</a> and is a Y Combinator 2024 <a href="https://www.ycombinator.com/blog/yc-top-companies-2024">Breakthrough Company</a>.</p></div><p>Reporting to the Senior Manager, Solutions Architect, you will lead and execute customer onboarding and technical delivery across Checkr's Guided API and partner integration programs. You will own a high volume of Guided API implementations end-to-end, deploy repeatable Workday integration patterns, and provide technical guidance and optimization support to existing customers. Partnering closely with Customer Success, Customer Support Engineering, Product, and Engineering, you will accelerate time-to-value for our customers and drive scalable platform adoption, fueling Checkr's growth.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead and execute high-volume Guided API customer implementations end to end, from initial technical kickoff through successful go-live.</li>
<li>Deliver Workday and other partner integrations using established, repeatable implementation frameworks and best practices.</li>
<li>Provide responsive technical guidance, troubleshooting, and optimization support for existing customers and Customer Success Managers.</li>
<li>Execute data queries and analyze payloads to validate system configurations, troubleshoot integration issues, and confirm solution integrity.</li>
<li>Identify, document, and escalate complex, non-standard, or high-risk architectural challenges to senior Solutions Architects and Engineering.</li>
<li>Contribute to continuous improvement of implementation runbooks, developer documentation, and standard operating procedures to increase team efficiency.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years of experience in technical consulting, solutions engineering, implementation, or a customer-facing technical delivery role.</li>
<li>Strong technical grasp of RESTful APIs, webhooks, JSON, and hosted versus embedded/self-hosted integration architectures.</li>
<li>Proven hands-on experience supporting or delivering HRIS, HCM, or ATS integrations (e.g., Workday).</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to write and run basic-to-moderate data queries to troubleshoot issues and validate technical workflows.</li>
<li>Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities, with a track record of managing a high volume of concurrent implementations without sacrificing quality or timeline commitments.</li>
<li>An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2>
<p>Chime is building a world-class Member Services organization, and the quality of that experience starts long before a member ever reaches an agent. It starts with how well that agent was trained. We're creating this role to raise the bar on two things at once: how consistently training gets delivered across our partner network, and how accountable our BPO partners are for delivering it well. As our Sr. Training Lead, you'll own training governance for Operations and Member Experience, spend real time in the classroom at our vendor sites training new hire agents yourself, and hold our partners' training teams to a higher standard than they've been held to before.</p>
<p>This is a new role on our Learning, Training, and Content Operations team. It's remote, with approximately 30% domestic and international travel to our BPO partner sites.</p>
<h2><strong>In this role, you can expect to</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own training execution across our lines of business, ensuring BPO trainers are facilitating our programs and content as expected, that agents are receiving the support they need during new hire training, that agents are completing training on time, and provide feedback to the Learning team about opportunities.</li>
<li>Guide a group of BPO master trainer contractors to drive training excellence with BPO training teams.</li>
<li>Travel to our partner sites roughly 30-40% of the time and train in the room, facilitating new hire classes, delivering Train-the-Trainer ahead of site launches and major releases, and co-facilitating alongside BPO trainers so you see delivery quality firsthand instead of reading about it.</li>
<li>Own trainer effectiveness at our BPOs end to end, including trainer certification and recertification, training lead calibration, a real observation and coaching cadence, and the decision about who is cleared to teach a Chime class.</li>
<li>Hold our BPO partners accountable for training delivery the way a vendor manager would: build the scorecard, run the governance cadence with partner training leadership, bring the data to business reviews, and drive corrective action plans when a site misses.</li>
<li>Measure what matters, using graduation rates (overall and on-time), nesting performance, speed to proficiency, trainer certification rates, and early-tenure quality and performance to find where delivery is breaking down and fix it.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Learning, Content, Quality, Workforce Management, Partner Operations, and LOB Operations so that launches land on time and agents are ready on day one.</li>
<li>Diagnose the gaps in how we train today and partner to rebuild the standard, bringing a point of view on what good looks like rather than waiting for it to be defined for you.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>To thrive in this role, you have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>7+ years in training, learning, or talent development within a contact center, BPO, or other high-volume service environment, including hands-on facilitation of new hire classes for frontline agents. You are still comfortable in front of a room.</li>
<li>Proven experience managing outsourced or BPO partners and holding them accountable for outcomes, including building performance metrics, governance frameworks, scorecards, and corrective action mechanisms. You've had the hard conversation with a vendor and kept the relationship.</li>
<li>Experience building training governance from the ground up: certification and train-the-trainer programs, facilitation standards, observation and coaching models, and the documentation that makes them hold up over time and under audit.</li>
<li>Strong coaching skills with other trainers, and the judgment to tell the difference between a content problem, a facilitation problem, and an operations problem.</li>
<li>Comfort with data, with the ability to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends across sites and vendors, and translate what you find into business requirements and decisions.</li>
<li>The ability to influence without authority across internal stakeholders and external partners at every level, from a trainer on the floor to a partner's site leadership.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 30-40% of the time. Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment is a plus.</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<p><strong>About the Team</strong></p>
<p>As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.</p>
<p>With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.</p>
<p>We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.&nbsp; With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit</li>
<li>Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines</li>
<li>Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isn’t always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.</li>
<li>Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind</li>
<li>Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't</li>
<li>Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics</li>
<li>Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team</li>
<li>Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly</li>
<li>Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident follow-up, and drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce technical debt and prevent recurring problems</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a long track record of designing, shipping, and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments</li>
<li>A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)</li>
<li>Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI</li>
<li>Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.</li>
<li>Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team</li>
<li>Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production</li>
<li>A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team</li>
<li>Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others</li>
<li>Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same</li>
<li>Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners</li>
<li>Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed</li>
<li>A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals</li>
<li>Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices</li>
<li>Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role is a Great Fit If</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows</li>
<li>You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality</li>
<li>You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work</li>
<li>You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example</li>
<li>You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others</li>
<li>You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it</li>
<li>You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first</li>
<li>You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Applying</strong></p>
<p>Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? <strong>Please apply anyway!</strong></p>
<p>When applying please include:&nbsp;</p>
<p>A resume or short listing of your job history &amp; skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About Netlify</strong></p>
<p>Netlify is a platform that lets you create, share, and run anything on the web: a website, an app, an agent experience, whatever you can dream up. Use your own tools or ours to build it, collaborate with your team, get it live, and keep it running. Anyone, from people just starting out to seasoned developers, can create pro-level web experiences that really work, really well.</p>
<p>We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!</p>
<p>At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $182,000 - $248,000 for most US-based locations, $175,000 - $235,000 CAD in most Canada-based locations, and £105,000 – £144,000 GBP for most UK-based locations.&nbsp; Candidates outside the US, Canada, UK, or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.&nbsp;</p>

<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.</p>
<p>We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.</p>
<p>We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.</p>
<p>You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.</p>
<p>This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.</p>
<h2>What you will do</h2>
<p><strong>Design the pipelines.</strong> Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.</p>
<p>We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.</p>
<p><strong>Evaluate new systems before we adopt them.</strong> Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.</p>
<p><strong>Build the evaluation process.</strong> You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Ship and operate.</strong> Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.</p>
<p><strong>Set direction.</strong> Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.</p>
<h2>What we are looking for</h2>
<p><strong>Required</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.</li>
<li>Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.</li>
<li>Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.</li>
<li>Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.</li>
<li>You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.</li>
<li>Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.</li>
<li>Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.</li>
<li>Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.</li>
<li>Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.</li>
<li>Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.</li>
<li>Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.</li>
<li>Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How we work and what we offer</h2>
<p>Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.</p>
<p>What we offer:</p>
<ul>
<li>A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software</li>
<li>Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.</li>
<li>Monthly payments in USD</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://bitovi.com">https://bitovi.com</a>
</p>

<h2>JOIN OUR TEAM!</h2>
<p>Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!<br><br><strong>Compensation:</strong> $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.</p>
<p><strong>PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>WHO YOU ARE</h2>
<p>You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.</p>
<p>You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:</p>
<ul>
<li>Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes</li>
<li>Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag</li>
<li>Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus</li>
<li>Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)</li>
<li>Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads</li>
<li>A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems</li>
<li>Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime</li>
<li>A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery</li>
<li>Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)</li>
<li>Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications</li>
<li>Database schema design and development expertise</li>
</ul>
<h2>Other skills we value</h2>
<p>Temporal depth</p>
<ul>
<li>Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud</li>
<li>Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations</li>
<li>Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)</li>
<li>Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud</li>
</ul>
<p>Kafka &amp; event streaming depth</p>
<ul>
<li>Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)</li>
<li>Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)</li>
<li>Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores</li>
<li>Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures</li>
</ul>
<h3>Platform / DevOps depth</h3>
<ul>
<li>Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams</li>
<li>GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model</li>
<li>Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar</li>
<li>Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs</li>
<li>Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)</li>
<li>Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)</li>
<li>EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale</li>
</ul>
<h3>General</h3>
<ul>
<li>Interest in working across multiple backend languages</li>
<li>Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)</li>
<li>API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)</li>
<li>AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)</li>
<li>Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)</li>
</ul>
<h2>WHO WE ARE</h2>
<p>Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.</p>
<p>We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.</p>
<p>We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.</p>
<p>Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI</h2>
<p><strong>Build durable systems.</strong> Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.</p>
<p><strong>Lead modernization efforts.</strong> Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.</p>
<p><strong>Own the platform.</strong> Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.</p>
<p><strong>Consult and manage.</strong> Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.</p>
<p><strong>Travel.</strong> This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.</p>
<p><strong>Teach.</strong> We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.</p>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>BENEFITS WE OFFER</h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity</li>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://edconic.com/">https://edconic.com/</a>
</p>

<div>
<p><strong>Job Title:</strong> Front-End Developer<br><strong>Location:</strong> Fully Remote (US)<br><strong>Department:</strong> Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director of Web Development<br><strong>Classification:</strong> Regular, Full-time<br><strong>FLSA Status:</strong> Exempt<br><strong>Prepared by:</strong> Global Head of Creative<br><strong>Prepared Date:</strong> 10/1/26<br><strong>Salary range:</strong>&nbsp;$85,000–$100,000</p>
<p><br><strong>About Edconic</strong></p>
<p>Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.</p>
<p><strong>Our Mission: </strong></p>
<p>Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our values</strong></p>
<p>• Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learner’s potential.</p>
<p>• Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another.</p>
<p>• Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts.</p>
<p><strong>The Role</strong></p>
<p>We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.</p>
<p>You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>
<div>
<ul>
<li>Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.</li>
<li>Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.</li>
<li>Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.</li>
<li>Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.</li>
<li>Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p>
<div>
<ul>
<li>4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.</li>
<li>The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.</li>
<li>Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.</li>
<li>Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.</li>
<li>A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.</li>
<li>Experience building and testing HTML emails.</li>
<li>Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.</li>
<li>A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p><strong>Bonus Experience</strong></p>
<div>
<ul>
<li>Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.</li>
<li>Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.</li>
<li>Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).</li>
<li>CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).</li>
<li>Multilingual WordPress sites.</li>
<li>A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.</li>
<li>UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p><br><strong>How We Use AI</strong></p>
<p>AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.</p>
<p>AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.</p>
<p><strong>Location, Travel &amp; Eligibility</strong></p>
<div>
<ul>
<li>Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.</li>
<li>Must be legally authorized to work in the US.</li>
<li>Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p><strong>Our Commitment</strong></p>
<p>Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.</p>
<p>The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.</p>
</div>

<item><title>Gusto, Inc.: Software Engineer,  Financial Data & Payments</title><region>Anywhere in the World</region><country></country><state></state><category>Full-Stack Programming</category><type>Full-Time</type><skills></skills><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 06:03:18 +0000</pubDate><link>https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-software-engineer-financial-data-payments</link><guid>https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-software-engineer-financial-data-payments</guid><description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Seattle, WA - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>About Gusto</strong></p>
<p>At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.</p>
<p>All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/total-rewards"> Total Rewards philosophy</a>.</p>
<p>AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.</p></div><h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2>
<p>We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on the financial backbone of Gusto's money movement — the ledger, reconciliation, and reporting systems that account for every dollar, and the payment profile that determines how employers fund payroll and how employees and contractors get paid. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by driving large technical architectural decisions (focusing on scale and modularity), understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!</p>
<h2><strong>About the Team:</strong></h2>
<p>Financial Data &amp; Payment Profile (FDPP) sits inside Gusto's Payments organization, which moves money safely between partners, employers, employees, government authorities, and Gusto. FDPP owns the two things that every one of those movements depends on.</p>
<p>Financial Data is the system of record for the money itself: the ledger and subledger behind every payment, the reconciliation that proves our books agree with our banks and partners, the investigation of the variances that surface when they do not, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, and Compliance depend on. When Gusto needs to answer where a dollar is — and prove it — the answer comes from systems this team builds.</p>
<p>Payment Profile is what makes a payment possible in the first place: the payment methods available to a customer, the bank accounts and connections behind them, the verification that makes those accounts trustworthy, and the profile state that decides whether a payment can happen at all. Hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on this being right the first time — and on it recovering gracefully when a bank account, a connection, or a preference changes.</p>
<h2><strong>Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Design, build, and test the financial data systems that record every dollar Gusto moves — the ledger and subledger that serve as the system of record, the transaction models underneath them, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, Compliance, and our partners rely on to close the books</li>
<li>Build reconciliation at Gusto's scale: prove that our internal records agree with bank, processor, and partner statements, and make the breaks that fall out of that comparison traceable rather than mysterious</li>
<li>Lead variance investigation end-to-end — the tooling, instrumentation, and runbooks that turn "the numbers don't tie" into a specific root cause, and then into a fix that eliminates the whole class of break</li>
<li>Own the payment profile: how employers are set up to fund payroll and how employees and contractors are set up to be paid — the payment methods available and the rules that govern which apply to whom, the bank accounts and connections behind them, and the verification state that determines whether money can move at all</li>
<li>Make setup and verification something a small business can finish on its own — instant bank verification, graceful handling of broken or revoked connections, and a clear path back to a payable state when something changes</li>
<li>Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world</li>
<li>Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Accounting, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams</li>
<li>Mentor and grow fellow engineers working to create holistic and scalable solutions</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Here’s what we're looking for:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience and the enthusiasm for a collaborative, test-driven environment</li>
<li>Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software as well as designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages</li>
<li>Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code that is maintainable, structured, and well-documented</li>
<li>An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems</li>
<li>Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs</li>
<li>Experience in one or more of these domains is strongly preferred: ledger or subledger design, financial reconciliation, accounting systems, or payments infrastructure</li>
<li>Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts — journal entries, chart of accounts, debits and credits, and tying a subledger out to the general ledger — and the ability to work with accountants and controllers in their own vocabulary</li>
<li>Experience building systems where correctness, auditability, and immutability matter more than raw throughput, and where a silent data error is worse than an outage</li>
<li>Bonus: Experience with bank account verification, payment rails (ACH, wire, RTP), or third-party banking data and verification providers</li>
<li>Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1">Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $183,000-$200,000 /yr in Denver &amp; most remote locations, and $222,000-$245,000 /yr for San Francisco, Seattle &amp; New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr>
<p>At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.</p>
<hr>
<p>Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.</p>
<p>Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.&nbsp;</p>
<p>When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.</p>
<p><strong>Reliable, consistent presence: </strong>We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.</p>
<hr>
<p><span>Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdEfl7Bp-Twz7LLlhGlha46CrxZ9Kacgakmarf3K2TbnaEgKQ/viewform">this form</a> and a member of our team will get in touch with you.</span></p>
<p>Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our <a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/fraudulent-activity-disclaimer">Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer</a>.</p>
<p>Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to&nbsp;<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/applicant-privacy-notice">Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-software-engineer-financial-data-payments">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gusto-inc-software-engineer-financial-data-payments</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title: Senior Commercial Account Manager</strong></p>
<p><strong>Location: United States, Remote</strong></p>
<p>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</p>
<p><strong>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</strong></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Senior Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Full-Cycle Account Ownership:</strong> Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.</li>
<li><strong>Driving Net-New Revenue:</strong> Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.</li>
<li><strong>Account Planning:</strong> Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.</li>
<li><strong>Proactive Retention Management:</strong> Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.</li>
<li><strong>Executive Relationship Building:</strong> Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.</li>
<li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Pipeline Accuracy:</strong> Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.</li>
<li><strong>Market &amp; Competitive Intelligence:</strong> Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Segmented Renewal Strategy:</strong> Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.</li>
</ul>
<p>In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Senior Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.</p>
<p>Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.</p>
<p>If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>Our Salesloft Senior Commercial Sales team is comprised of motivated sales professionals with a strong desire to win.</p>
<p>Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.</p>
<p>The Senior Commercial Account Management team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The AMs on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4+ years of proven relationship building and closing experience in a sales environment.</li>
<li>Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships</li>
<li>Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the SMB segment</li>
<li>Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers</li>
<li>Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.</li>
<li>Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'</li>
<li>Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning sceptics into ecstatic new customers</li>
<li>High level of empathy - it's important for our AM's to be a good person to peers and prospects.</li>
<li>Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.</li>
<li>Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.</li>
<li>Proven ability to make strong connections and overcome rejection to achieve results.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to conduct compelling on-site and virtual presentations to C-Level executives.</li>
</ul>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page (<a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">https://salesloft.com/company/careers/</a>).</p>
<p>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, United States; San Mateo, CA; Toronto, Canada
</p>

<div class="job-post-container">
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-post-content">
<h1><img src="https://res.cloudinary.com/o2bwt8ar/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/CockroachLabs_Symbol_Black_2" alt="" width="92"></h1>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1>Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1>
<p>For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed. &nbsp;</p>
<p>At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity. &nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<h2><span><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Storage Team to help shape and build CockroachDB’s storage systems. Storage is the foundation of CockroachDB, responsible for the safe, durable and efficient persistence and retrieval of data, on top of which the rest of the database is built. Our team develops and maintains <a href="https://www.cockroachlabs.com/blog/pebble-rocksdb-kv-store/">Pebble</a>, an innovative Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree storage engine purpose built for Multi Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) data, and <a href="https://www.cockroachlabs.com/blog/continuum-architecture/#Cockroach-Plenum:-Disaggregated-Storage-for-Elastic-Infrastructure">Plenum</a>, the elastic, disaggregated storage layer that separates a cluster’s storage from its compute and allows them to scale independently.&nbsp;</p>
<p>In this role, you’ll bring deep storage expertise to complex problems spanning Pebble, Plenum, encryption at rest (EAR), CockroachDB’s storage interfaces, and the cloud environments in which they operate. You’ll work hands-on, lead the design and delivery of significant improvements, and help the team make sound tradeoffs among durability, performance, scalability, cost, and operational simplicity.</p>
<h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Work on hard technical problems.</strong> Apply your deep knowledge of storage systems to solve technical challenges at the core of CockroachDB and its storage layers.</li>
<li><strong>Lead through collaboration.</strong> Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify, design, and drive significant Storage initiatives, making tradeoffs clear and building alignment across involved teams.</li>
<li><strong>Be a trusted partner across the company.</strong> Work closely and collaboratively with other engineers across the database and cloud organizations, product, support, and field engineering.</li>
<li><strong>Set the standard for engineering excellence.</strong> Raise the effectiveness of the team through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Help the team leverage AI to produce high-quality software in a modern development environment.</li>
<li><strong>Ship mission-critical software.</strong> Ensure that CockroachDB remains scalable, survivable, and consistent as we continue to grow as a company. We work in Go and Rust, but if you don't know them, you'll learn while you're here.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2>
<p>In your first 30 days, you will establish relationships with the Storage team and learn about the Storage team’s domain and CockroachDB architecture. You will ship your first project.</p>
<p>After 3 months, you will be fully integrated into the team and comfortable contributing to the Storage team’s roadmap in partnership with Product. You’ll have built an understanding of the Storage team’s tech stack and feel comfortable with the architecture and components the team develops and maintains.</p>
<p>After 6 months, you will have led a meaningful piece of Storage work and participate in the Storage oncall rotation.</p>
<h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Deep systems experience</strong>. 8+ years building complex distributed systems or storage software, including significant time working on distributed systems, concurrency control, file systems, data replication, I/O performance, or memory management.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Storage architecture expertise</strong>. You have built or evolved a storage system such as log-structured merge-trees, blob storage, or cloud object storage.</li>
<li><strong>Production experience.</strong> Experience building, running, and debugging large-scale distributed systems in production and evolving systems through rolling upgrades.</li>
<li><strong>A collaborative approach.</strong> You have a passion for solving hard technical problems with others, sharing context, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback, and helping teammates succeed. You enjoy mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on ability.</strong> You write production-ready code in systems programming languages like Go, Rust, or C/C++. You dig into hard bugs, profiles, and incidents when it matters.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Rachael Harding - Manager, Engineering</strong></p>
<p>Rachael leads the Storage team within the Database Engineering organization, where she oversees the development of Pebble and Plenum. Based in the Bay Area with her family, Rachael enjoys sampling pastries, exploring local parks, and baking with her kids.</p>
<p><strong>Nick Travers - Director, Engineering</strong></p>
<p>Nick joined Cockroach Labs in 2021 and leads Database Engineering - the group of teams building CockroachDB. Originally from Perth, Australia, he lives in Los Angeles with his family. Arsenal supporter, cook, outdoors person.</p>
<p><strong>Isaac Wong - EVP of Research &amp; Development</strong></p>
<p>Isaac is responsible for the health of the engineering organization at Cockroach Labs. He partners closely with teams to ensure we have a balanced culture that promotes quality and innovation in pursuit of our goals. Before joining Cockroach Labs Isaac was in life sciences for 16 years with Medidata Solutions where he had a front row seat on the exciting ride from a 30 person startup to more than 2000 people worldwide. But the lure of distributed, resilient, and consistent SQL databases, along with the amazing technology and culture at Cockroach Labs proved too much. When not working he likes to draw, play the piano, and search NYC for cannoli's with his wife and kids.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p>
<p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p>

<li><em>Nice to have: </em>Experience with designing and building external facing APIs and AI Agent Integration</li>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span><strong>The Community You Will Join: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>People Analytics &amp; Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p>
<p>The People Analytics &amp; Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity &amp; Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.</p>
<p><span><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze</li>
<li>Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others</li>
<li>Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business</li>
<li>Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders</li>
<li>Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards</li>
<li>Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting</li>
<li>Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb</li>
<li>Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver</li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field</li>
<li>Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis</li>
<li>Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access</li>
<li>Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit</li>
<li>Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data</li>
<li>Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact</li>
<li>Experience working with large practical datasets</li>
